title: Start Work
description: inbox/START.md, what the worker reads first; its path is the launch argument. Carried as its 3 parts: the task.yaml path and, on a retry, the rescue commit and the progress notes of the last attempt.

task_yaml.description: Absolute path of the task.yaml of the task.

rescue_commit.description: Optional, retry only. The commit of the rescue ref that the worker starts from.

progress_notes.description: Optional, retry only. The progress notes of the last attempt.
